hero.label: OFFICIAL 2026 SESSION
hero.title:
MKR CAMP 2026

hero.subtitle: From August 17 to September 5, 2026 in Dagestan. You pick 1, 2, or 3 weeks within the window. Adults only, 15 places, collective spirit. Applications are open.

stats.weeks_label: Weeks of your choice · August 17 to September 5

cinematic.alt: Group of athletes in formation at MKR Camp
cinematic.label: THE FLAGSHIP SESSION
cinematic.title:
ONE CAMP. ONE GROUP.
1 TO 3 WEEKS.
cinematic.tagline: You travel with adult athletes from around the world. You pick 1, 2, or 3 weeks. You come back with a new level and a fighting family.

esprit.title: Collective spirit
esprit.desc: You join a group of adult athletes from France, Switzerland, Belgium, and beyond. Within 48 hours, you train, eat, and recover together. The brotherhood of the mat does the rest.

dates.title: Fixed dates, proven organization
dates.desc: From August 17 to September 5, 2026, a 3-week window. You choose your duration (1, 2, or 3 weeks) based on your schedule. MKR locked in the visa, flights, accommodation, program, and coaches months ago.

historique.title: The flagship format
historique.desc: This has been our signature session from the start. Most alumni come back the following year, sometimes with a friend, sometimes with their teenager. When someone says they did MKR, this is usually the camp.

slots.label: Registration
slots.desc: You fill out the form. Reply within 48 hours.

slots.label: Kickoff call + payment
slots.desc: Validation video call with Ruslan. If approved: bank details sent, full payment by transfer. Russian visa application started by MKR.

slots.label: 6-week prep program
slots.desc: You receive the remote physical prep program. Russian visa being finalized, MKR confirms the Istanbul-Makhachkala domestic flight schedule.

slots.label: Visa finalized
slots.desc: Russian visa in hand. You can book your international flight to Istanbul (MKR domestic flight already locked in).

slots.label: Final briefing
slots.desc: Logistics, flight, transfers, and confirmed packing list briefing.

slots.label: Departure
slots.desc: You take your flight to Istanbul. Istanbul-Makhachkala domestic flight included. MKR vehicle at the airport in Dagestan.

sur_mesure.label: CUSTOM
sur_mesure.title: Your own dates
sur_mesure.desc: Want to choose your dates? 1 to 4 adults, duration of your choice, 90-day minimum lead time.

famille.label: FAMILY
famille.title: Family Camp
famille.desc: Traveling with a child aged 8 to 17? Adapted parent and child program.

clubs.label: CLUB AND GROUP
clubs.title: Your club in the Caucasus
clubs.desc: Bringing 5 or more people (club or organized group)? Dedicated camp, Wrestling in Dagestan or MMA in Chechnya. Custom quote.
